verdict: Reporting services point failed after TLS 1.2 enforcement. Site server or site system components do not meet the TLS 1.2 prereqs (strong-crypto .NET, WinHTTP default protocols, SQL native client).
fix: Apply the TLS 1.2 readiness checklist on every site server and site system: (1) install the .NET 4.6+ strong-crypto update and set `SchUseStrongCrypto=1` under `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\.NETFramework\v4.0.30319` and its Wow6432Node twin; (2) set WinHTTP default secure protocols to include TLS 1.2; (3) update SQL Server Native Client to a TLS 1.2-capable build. Reboot after changes. SSRS will re-register on next SMS_Executive cycle.
